description: Election Commission - K. L. S. R. Jayakodi was elected as the member of the No. 03 Udagama of Buttala Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Buttala Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, which is an electoral process matter. It specifically operates under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and involves the declaration of a newly elected member to fill the vacant seat. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members for local authorities.
